answer: To stop Sybil attacks, deploy Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, each agent must lock $5,000 into a smart contract. Second, the local hardware enclave generates a unique cryptographic proof. Third, the network verifies this proof against the locked bond. To subvert this, an attacker incurs $50,000 in bonds and 14 days of hardware provisioning. This mechanism builds a secure island of identity. It ensures truth stays high like a knoll, preventing lies from shifting like a sand dune. This creates a fortress where only verified, bonded actors can truly exist.
